hits.title: Valuation of Variations

args.content: This is a valid Variation because the Engineer may instruct changes before completion, including by revised drawing, and each Variation must be confirmed by a Variation Instruction; a Variation is any change instructed under clause 13.1 and clause 1.1. Valuation is by measurement of the change in quantities using BOQ rates where the work is of similar character and executed under similar conditions; a new rate is only for no similar item, and no percentage addition for preliminaries or overheads is allowed under clauses 13.3 and 13.4. The change is not a lump sum item issue on the evidence provided. EOT, if any, is only to the extent completion is delayed by the Variation, assessed on the current programme by critical path and float under clause 8.4. If granted, time-related costs are AED 2,500 [F-0539] per working day [F-0539] under clause 8.5, and no other time-related costs are payable. Acceleration is only if the Employer instructs it, with crew costs under clause 8.6. Notice is required within 28 [F-0543] days [F-0543] of awareness under clause 20.1. Design responsibility for structural design rests with the Employer’s design consultant under clause 4.1, so this paving change does not itself raise a design-responsibility question on the contract text. I have asked commercial to confirm whether the BOQ rate applies or a new rate is needed under clause 13.3.
